title: The Four Trees: Ashenvale

objectives.text: Go to the edge of Bough Shadow

texts.details:
The second tree stands in our own Ashenvale, in the far east, beyond where the orcs are cutting. Bough Shadow. Go to its edge, as you did before.

You asked who planted them. I will tell you, though it is not told gladly. They are not wild. Each is a sapling of Nordrassil, the World Tree. The Archdruid Fandral Staghelm cut branches from it, long ago, and set them in the earth with his own hands, and he did not ask the Circle's leave. The Circle was furious. But the trees grew, and each opened a way into the Dream, and so they were left standing.

A thing made in defiance does not always grow straight. West of the tree, among the roots, a treant has gone to rot. End it, $N.
texts.objectives: Go to the edge of Bough Shadow in eastern Ashenvale and kill Bough-Rot, a treant to the west of it. Return to Loganaar in Nighthaven.
texts.progress: You will see the green ones about the trunk. Do not go among them.
texts.completion:
Two doors. And you have seen the keepers.

Those about the trunk are dragonkin of the green flight, and above them, if you looked up, one of the great ones. Ysera set four of her most trusted over the four trees: Ysondre here, Taerar in Duskwood, Lethon in the Hinterlands, Emeriss in Feralas. They were the wardens of the doors.

I say "were." You are not ready for the rest, but you are ready for this: take one of these. The road gets longer from here. At forty seasons, come back, and I will send you over the sea again.

idea: The Four Trees, level 30: Bough Shadow. From the wiki: the Great Trees are saplings of Nordrassil that Fandral Staghelm planted without the Cenarion Circle's approval, to its fury; Ysera's lieutenants Ysondre, Lethon, Emeriss and Taerar watched over them. Invented: Bough-Rot.
